This '''individual''' commanded the personal [[Xizor's navy|navy]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] led Xizor's navy from aboard ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'', Xizor's [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], during the [[Battle over Coruscant]], in which he and Xizor were killed.
